properties.description:
* WHAT...North winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 40 mph.

* WHERE...Portions of south central and southwest Alabama, northwest
Florida, and southeast Mississippi.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Strong and gusty winds will be capable of downing
numerous additional compromised trees which would result in renewed
power outages in vulnerable areas impacted by the extreme winds
during Hurricane Isaias. In addition, large debris piles from storm
cleanup may be blown about resulting in additional hazards to
anyone nearby outdoors along with potentially blocking previously
cleared roadways. Additional road closures will be possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Many trees are leaning over power lines,
homes, and roads in the impacted area. Frequent wind gusts between
35 and 40 mph will create dangerous conditions outdoors in the
vulnerable areas. Elsewhere, winds may result in large tree
branches downed and localized power outages.
properties.instruction:
Use extreme caution if you must travel or be outdoors Friday night
through Saturday. Remain alert for potential falling trees and power
lines, blown debris, and additional damage to structures that remain
compromised from the hurricane.

properties.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 1 AM CDT SATURDAY DUE TO
WIND SHIFT, MOISTURE DROP AND WIND, LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR
PORTIONS OF NORTH CENTRAL, NORTHWEST LOUISIANA, PORTIONS OF SOUTH
CENTRAL, SOUTHWEST ARKANSAS, NORTHWEST LOUISIANA, SOUTHEAST OKLAHOMA,
EAST, AND NORTHEAST TEXAS...

...RED FLAG WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 9 AM TO 7 PM CDT SATURDAY
DUE TO WIND SHIFT, MOISTURE DROP AND WIND, LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR
PORTIONS OF NORTH CENTRAL AND NORTHWEST LOUISIANA...

* AFFECTED AREA...Portions of north central and northwest Louisiana.

* TIMING...For the first Red Flag Warning, until 1 AM CDT Saturday.
For the second Red Flag Warning, from 9 AM to 7 PM CDT Saturday.

* WINDS...For the first Red Flag Warning, north winds 10 to 15 mph
with gusts up to 30 mph, and for the second Red Flag Warning,
northeast winds 5 to 15 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...For the first Red Flag Warning, Relative
Humidity between 46 to 54 percent, and for the second Red Flag
Warning, Relative Humidity between 25 to 35 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the field of
this Red Flag Warning.

Follow all fire restrictions. One less spark, one less wildfire.

A Red Flag Warning is issued when we identify weather conditions that
promote rapid spread of fire which may become life-threatening. This
does not mean there is a fire. These conditions are either occurring
now or will begin soon. It is important to have multiple ways to
receive information from authorities.

northeast winds 5 to 15 mph with gusts up to 30 mph.

Warning, Relative Humidity between 25 to 35 percent.

burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the field of
this Red Flag Warning.

Follow all fire restrictions. One less spark, one less wildfire.

A Red Flag Warning is issued when we identify weather conditions that
promote rapid spread of fire which may become life-threatening. This
does not mean there is a fire. These conditions are either occurring
now or will begin soon. It is important to have multiple ways to
receive information from authorities.
